steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Change the event type from the default RFP to Auction.
Select the forward auction template required by the case.
Add the specified product with requested quantity 10.
Render and populate the pricing sheet after adding the line item.
Verify the requested quantity remains 10 in the first row.

args.goal: set the first line item's Plant Name to LOC-0001 and stop when the sheet visibly shows LOC-0001

steps.note: Set the plant location, which has no dedicated catalog argument.
Enter a price so Total Amount can be calculated.
Verify the total is calculated as price 100 multiplied by quantity 10.
